content.text: The model check confirms 2G523 is not recalled, so the claim is denied.

reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model 2G523, which is not one of the recalled models (2G505, 2G520, 2G505B, 2G512B). The typed model matches this result, so the device is not covered by the recall.

The retailer (Homedepot.com) and purchase date (2025-06-06) are within the listed retailers and sale window, and no duplicate claims were found. These facts do not change the outcome because the model is not recalled.

The destruction photo does not show the required 'Recalled' written in permanent marker on the product; the lettering appears printed or digitally rendered. This is a further deficiency, though it is not the basis for the denial.
